name: Aura Kingdom - Impact
detailed_description:
The classic Japanese anime fantasy MMORPG world, Aura Kingdom: Impact, officially returns with a global version launching soon!

Featuring a passionate anime style, stunning characters, and elements of fantastical adventure. Players will experience the brand-new class "Floating Cannon," along with innovative gameplay such as Eidolon Inlay and free weapon switching, delivering an unparalleled adventure experience.

"Awaken Resonance! Eidolon Awakening, Fateful Fracas begins now!"

Form contracts with Eidolons, connect destinies, and resonate to forge the strongest Ties That Bind! Protect the origin, conquer fate! Venture into the fantasy world alongside your Eidolon and explore the infinite possibilities brought by Eidolon Awakening.

Global Version Game Features

[New Class "Floating Cannon" — A technological revolution of elemental Rift!]

Harnessing ice and fire elements with the ability to switch attributes, it gains temporary superpower through "Rift Mode." In battle, entering Rift Mode allows the Floating Cannon to attack with a secondary attribute for enhanced strikes, neutralizing potential effects between attributes.

[Free Weapon Switching — Your combat style, your choice!]

No need to retrain characters: Experience different Skills combinations without recreating characters. Freely switch main weapons to adapt to various battle scenarios and craft your unique combat style.

[Eidolon Inlay × Resonance System — Create your exclusive combat archetype!]

Equip Skills with Eidolons: Alter combat effects and create exclusive fighting styles. Reduce the burden of strengthening new Eidolons and easily cultivate ultimate power. Focus on leveling up primary Eidolons while newly acquired ones can level up using the Resonance system.

[Weapon Inlay × Enhancement System — Forge your personalized divine weapon!]

Cultivate exclusive divine weapons: Enhance weapon specialization levels to unlock more gem inlay slots. Customize diverse combinations to create your ultimate personal weapon.

[Convenience System × Global Communication Without Borders]

Origin Helper: Offers features like automatic Item usage and discarding Items for easier character management.

Language switching and real-time translation: Eliminate communication barriers and foster connections among global players.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Win10/Win11
  • Processor: Intel Pentium4 2.8 GHz and above, AMD K8 2600+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nVidia GeForce 8400 and above, ATI Radeon X1600 and above
  • Storage: 14 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Win10/Win11
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo 2.66 GHz and above, AMD Athlon 64 X2 6000+
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: nVidia GeForce 9500 and above, ATI Radeon HD4570 and above
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
